title: Senior Backend Engineer
how_to_apply: Use the Greenhouse apply URL. Paste the cover letter in Additional Information.
description: Northstar Health is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own FastAPI services that sit in front of clinical and billing data. You will design PostgreSQL schemas, put Redis in front of hot paths, and run the stack on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. We care about pytest coverage, CI/CD, and Grafana-quality observability. Experience with Kafka or event-driven billing is a plus. This is a remote United States role.

title: Full Stack Engineer
how_to_apply: Apply on Lever with resume and the generated letter.
description: Lumen Freight needs a Full Stack Engineer to extend our Django REST APIs and a React TypeScript dashboard used by dispatchers. You will ship product weekly, write SQL against PostgreSQL, and collaborate with ops on workflow bugs. Docker-based local dev is required. Redis caching and pytest are part of the daily toolkit.

title: Data Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse form. Attach resume; paste letter in cover letter field.
description: Atlas Metrics is building a warehouse-centric analytics platform. The Data Engineer will write Python and SQL, operate Airflow DAGs, and stream events through Kafka into Spark jobs on AWS. Experience modeling facts and dimensions, plus dbt or Snowflake, is helpful. We want people who have backfilled messy historical data without downtime.

title: Platform Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever apply. Do not submit without reviewing the packet.
description: Harbor Cloud is hiring a Platform Engineer to own Terraform, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions for 20+ microservices. You will improve CI/CD, cut AWS spend, and make Docker builds reproducible. Python is the glue language for internal tools. Grafana, Prometheus, and on-call hygiene are part of the job.

title: Frontend Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse. Portfolio or GitHub required.
description: Pixel & Form wants a Frontend Engineer fluent in React and TypeScript. You will rebuild a design-system-heavy dashboard, improve CSS performance, and work in Vite. GraphQL experience is useful. This role is on-site in New York several days a week.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever. Include GitHub and a short note on a model you shipped.
description: Vector Labs ships ranking models used in production search. The ML Engineer will train PyTorch models, wrap them in Python services, and deploy with Docker on AWS. We value people who have owned evaluation, not only notebooks. Hugging Face, RAG, or LLM fine-tuning experience is welcome but not required.

title: Software Engineering Intern
how_to_apply: Greenhouse intern form. Use the generated letter.
description: Summer intern role helping the product squad. You will write Python services, a little React, and SQL against PostgreSQL. Mentorship is structured. Git fluency and a public GitHub with class or side projects is enough. Seattle office.

title: Application Security Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever. Do not include secrets in the letter.
description: Ember Pay is a payments company hiring AppSec. You will threat-model FastAPI and Django services, review OAuth and JWT flows, and partner with platform on Kubernetes hardening in AWS. Python scripting for scanners is expected. PCI experience is a plus.

title: Python Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse. Paste tailored bullets into the resume if you rewrite it.
description: Fieldnote builds field-ops software for contractors. We need a Python Engineer to grow FastAPI modules, keep PostgreSQL migrations honest, and use Redis for job queues. Pytest is non-negotiable. Celery or similar async workers would help. Remote in the US; Austin office optional.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever EU entity. Confirm work authorization yourself.
description: Nimbus Mail is hiring an SRE to run Kubernetes clusters, Terraform, and alerting in Prometheus and Grafana. Python is used for operators and runbooks. Linux production experience required. On-call is shared. Remote within the EU.

title: Mobile Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse. Link to App Store or Play build if you have one.
description: Cobalt Ride wants a Mobile Engineer comfortable in React Native with TypeScript. Native Swift knowledge helps for performance work. You will ship weekly to riders in Los Angeles. This is not a remote role.

title: Developer Experience Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever. A docs PR or public guide is a strong extra.
description: Quill Docs makes API documentation products. The DX Engineer will write Python and JavaScript tooling, improve CI/CD for preview docs, and build small React examples. You should enjoy turning confusing APIs into copy-paste guides. Remote worldwide.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse. Expect a system-design interview.
description: Marble Bank is hiring Staff Backend to lead system design for ledger services. Python and Java both appear in the stack. Kafka, PostgreSQL, and AWS are daily tools. You will mentor senior engineers and set the bar for production incidents. Hybrid New York.

title: Data Scientist
how_to_apply: Lever. A short write-up of an analysis is welcome.
description: Orchid Climate needs a Data Scientist who can move between pandas, SQL, and scikit-learn without getting stuck in slides. You will build features, evaluate models, and partner with engineers to ship Python jobs. Climate domain interest helps; production instinct helps more.

title: Backend Engineer (Go)
how_to_apply: Greenhouse. Go samples on GitHub preferred.
description: Keel Networks writes control-plane software in Go. gRPC, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes are the core. Linux networking curiosity is useful. Python shows up only in tests and glue. If your strongest language is Python, this will be a stretch.

title: Support Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever. Keep the letter short; this team reads every one.
description: Paperboat is a SaaS company hiring a Support Engineer. You will reproduce bugs, write SQL, read Python stack traces, and file clean GitHub issues. Linux comfort matters. This is a junior-friendly remote US role with a path onto the product team.

title: DevOps Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse civic tech form.
description: Redwood Civic needs DevOps for public-interest software. Terraform, AWS, Docker, and GitHub Actions are the backbone. Python automates the boring glue. Hybrid Portland. You should enjoy explaining infrastructure to developers who do not live in YAML.

title: Web Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever UK. Confirm right to work in the UK yourself.
description: Zinc Media publishes news products on Next.js. We need a Web Engineer strong in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and CSS. Python is not used on this team. Remote in the United Kingdom.

title: API Engineer
how_to_apply: Greenhouse. Never paste card data into the letter.
description: Boulder Payments is hiring an API Engineer for FastAPI services that issue OAuth tokens and move money metadata — never raw cards — through PostgreSQL and Redis on AWS. Idempotency, pytest, and careful logging matter. Remote US with a Denver office.

title: New Grad Software Engineer
how_to_apply: Lever new-grad form.
description: Maple Analytics hires new graduates onto a Python and SQL team with a small React UI. You will pair daily, learn Git workflows, and ship well-tested changes. Boston office. Internships or substantial GitHub projects are the bar.
